exposure: frozen embryo transfer (ET) in the immediately subsequent menstrual cycle (within 30 days of oocyte retrieval)
delayed frozen ET (after >30 days following oocyte retrieval)
cohort: The study included 198 women who underwent frozen embryo transfer following freeze-all cycles, with 119 in the immediate transfer group and 79 in the delayed transfer group.
finding: Adjusted analyses showed no significant difference in live birth rates between immediate and delayed frozen embryo transfers, although median birthweight was significantly higher in the delayed transfer group.
birth_weight: Median birthweight was 3195 g in the immediate transfer group and 3520 g in the delayed transfer group.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 267.5 days in the immediate transfer group and 268 days in the delayed transfer group.
